admission.justification: Burst coalescing is the rail family guarantee burst leg; typed per-case proofs were withdrawn as extractor-unsupported. Quiet-window prose claims only per-window latest forwarding.

applicability: Selection bursts arriving while the control channel is not ready, in same-turn and successive-turn patterns.
conditions: A trailing settle window is armed per unavailable display.
Ready report, Retry, host return, deadline or superseding display preempts the window.
exclusions: Ready channel, which switches by immediate message.
Settled selections, which are never asked twice.

evidence: reviewer corrected 4-case oracle 4/4 (pair C, same C, ready retains frame + latest ar.open C, triple D; all zero-message-substitute) + full vitest population PASS + typecheck + eslint

statement: Selections changed faster than the application answers resolve to exactly the latest selection loading after the burst settles, with no intermediate selection ever starting a load.
